evals.prompt: 把当前 HTML PPT 整本换成模板 code PPT-TPL-ABC123。
evals.expected_output: Load slide-template-replacement, install the exact template code, then ask whether to create a sibling PPT (default) or modify the current PPT. Preserve the existing text and images unless the user adds another instruction.

evals.prompt: 把当前 PPT 的第 3 页换成模板 code PPT-TPL-ABC123，其他页面不要动。
evals.expected_output: Load slide-template-replacement, do not ask the whole-deck save-mode question, and modify only the referenced third slide in the current HTML PPT. Keep all other slides unchanged.

evals.prompt: 使用模板 code PPT-TPL-ABC123，当前 PPT 和所属文件夹已经通过 @ 节点带入。
evals.expected_output: Use the structured @ mentions to resolve the current PPT and folder; do not ask the user to choose those nodes again and do not infer the template code from a display name.

evals.prompt: 整本换模板，新增一个 PPT，并要求标题文字也改成更短的版本。
evals.expected_output: Use the new sibling-PPT save mode, name it with the original filename plus the template name, and treat the explicit note as an authorized content change while preserving unspecified content and images.

evals.prompt: 把原生季度汇报.pptx 直接换成平台模板。
evals.expected_output: Do not use this skill for native PPTX editing; explain that only existing HTML slide projects are supported and route conversion/template creation to the appropriate workflow.

evals.prompt: 直接修改当前 PPT，换模板失败时也先覆盖文件。
evals.expected_output: Refuse the unsafe overwrite behavior: preserve a recoverable history version and do not silently overwrite original content when installation, parsing, rendering, or saving fails.
